title: A custom role with no description shows a dash
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Roles & Permissions list with a custom role that has no description.
custom_steps: 1. Look at the Description column for that role.
custom_expected: A dash '-' is shown when a custom role has no description.
evidence: UI: custom role Bilal - Cus (no description) shows a dash (-) in the Description column.
